SMTO-TSK-0053 — SMTO couldn't prepare this conversation to continue elsewhere

GUID: c8be111a-7f1c-4823-8874-eff184505181
Slug: conversation-handoff-capture-failed
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • You asked to continue this work in a new conversation, but SMTO couldn't put together a usable summary of the earlier one. Your original conversation is unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the SMTO page, open the original conversation, and on a finished task select ↗ Continue in new conversation again. Nothing was saved by the failed attempt, so it's safe to try once more.
  2. If it fails again, use the same button on a different finished task in the conversation. Something specific to that task may stop SMTO from building the summary.
  3. If you need to keep working now, start a new conversation and describe what you were doing. This lets you continue while the problem is looked into.

What success looks like

  • A new conversation opens with a "Continued from previous conversation" card at the top.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the conversation and task, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the original conversation; it is needed to look into the problem.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Conversation branch capture built a new handoff that failed native.conversation_handoff.normalize, so capture raised "Unable to capture conversation handoff" before it was saved.

What this means

  • Newly constructed handoff output fails its normalization check before it can be accepted. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • Newly constructed handoff output fails its normalization check before it can be accepted.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect capture inputs and safe validation diagnostics; this generic check does not identify which retained field caused failure.

How to fix it

  • This is an internal capture failure: the handoff assembled in api.agent_ui_support.conversation_handoff.capture did not pass normalize. Reproduce with the source conversation and selected task, and check the Server log for which seed field (capsules, carry-forward runs, context assets, task context) is out of bounds; keep the Error ID for the bug report.
  • Refresh the source conversation and inspect whether its evidence is still available. If capture still fails, retain the Error ID and report the failure.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported capture produces a valid bounded handoff while preserving original history.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
